body:
In this jail there is no systemd, no dbus, no umbriel, no ghostty and no notify-send. Sessions started here die with the jail (c-devjail).

Consequence: every integration must be an out-of-process command invoked by the host, and the core must behave correctly when a launcher, an IPC command or a notifier is absent — degrade to plain zmx behaviour, never fail the primary verb. Host-side integrations are checked by hand, and the README says which ones only exist on which machine.
title: Every integration point is on the host, not in the jail
